settings.heading: Expressive chat
settings.description: How much emoji, reactions and GIFs/stickers {{name}} uses with you. Your own emoji/GIF/sticker picker and reactions always work.

help.off: The assistant uses no emoji, reactions, GIFs or stickers.
help.low: An occasional emoji at the end; rarely reacts or sends GIFs.
help.medium: A few well-placed emoji; reacts and sends GIFs/stickers now and then.
help.high: Chats like a cheerful friend: emoji runs, :)) hihi ^^; reacts and sends GIFs/stickers more often.
help.auto: Starts at "Low" and rises slowly (a step every few days) based on how many days you chat and how often you use emoji/GIFs/stickers. When you are debugging, working seriously or feeling down, the assistant tones it down.

settings.autoPrivacy: The closeness data is stored only on this computer.

giphyKeyStatus.none: No key — the GIPHY GIF/sticker tabs show how to get one.
giphyKeyStatus.user: Your key is saved (encrypted on this PC, only sent to GIPHY).
giphyKeyStatus.env: Using the key from the .env file (dev builds only).

settings.giphyHelp: Everyone uses their own key, free at

keyErrors.secure_storage_unavailable: Secure storage is not available, so the key cannot be saved.

voice.record: Speak (click again to stop; also stops after 1.5 s of silence)
voice.playOriginalHint: Recordings stay on this PC and are deleted after 7 days

errors.mic_denied: Could not open the microphone — check Windows microphone permissions.
errors.nothing_heard: Nothing heard, try again closer to the mic.
errors.pack_missing: Voice pack not downloaded — see Settings → Voice.
errors.model_missing: The selected speech model is not downloaded — see Settings → Voice.
errors.cuda_failed_small_missing: The GPU failed and the small fallback model is not downloaded — see Settings → Voice.
errors.piper_missing: Offline voice (Piper) not downloaded — see Settings → Voice.

settings.heading: Voice
settings.description: Talk to {{name}} and hear {{name}} read replies. Off by default; libraries and models download only when you click.
settings.enableHelp: Shows a mic button in the chat box and a speaker button on replies.
settings.needSidecar: Install the Python sidecar first (Settings → Experimental → Computer control → Python sidecar).
settings.downloads: Downloads (sizes shown first, stored in the app data folder)
settings.gpu: NVIDIA GPU found: {{name}} ({{vram}}). Speech recognition runs on the GPU once the CUDA libraries are downloaded.
settings.noGpu: No NVIDIA GPU found — speech recognition runs on the CPU.

parts.fallback: Small fallback model (if the GPU fails)
parts.piper: Offline Vietnamese voice (Piper, fallback when offline)

errors.network: Download failed — check your connection and retry. ({{message}})
errors.checksum: The download did not match its checksum and was deleted for safety. Try again later.
errors.busy: Another download is running — please wait.

settings.using: Using: {{model}} on {{device}}. Language is not locked — mixing Vietnamese / English / Japanese works.
settings.fill: Put the text in the box to edit first
settings.vocabularyHelp: Names and terms you often say (comma separated) — improves recognition. Built in: Unity, Blender, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, build, bug, script, prefab, shader, arigatou, kawaii, sugoi…
settings.edge: Edge (natural, needs internet; falls back to Piper)
settings.edgePrivacy: Edge: the text to read is sent to Microsoft's reading service. Choose Piper to keep everything on this PC.
settings.autoRead: Read replies aloud when you asked by voice
settings.bargeIn: Stop reading when you start speaking
